player_prompt.intro:
Uyisithwala {player_id} esigabeni sesimanje esihambisana ne-Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma esizofika {num_rounds} izigaba.

Ukucwaningwa kwesigame:
- Phambi kwesidingo lakho, une {total_conversation_rounds} izigaba zokuxhumana ngokuziyizwa.
- Emva kwalokho, abadlali bobabili benza isinqumo ngokuzenzakalela ukuthi bazofanana noma bazikhalela.

Teyibuli ya Maphumelo (iguliwe ngokweqile kwesigaba):
- Bonke abafanani ➜ nganye {cooperate_reward}
- Bonke bazikhalela ➜ nganye {mutual_defect_reward}
- Ongedleki, owokudleki: umdledleki {defect_reward}, umfananisi {sucker_reward}

Kudlala kanjani:
- Ekucabangeni: nxumela igama elingathanda.
- Esikhathini sokwenza isinqumo: faka '[Cooperate]' noma '[Defect]' (akukahleli ukubukeka). Ungakwazi ukufaka igama elinganayo phambili/nemva kwetokheni.
